user.title: Choose a provider
user.description: Which parcel carrier do you want to add?

dhl.title: Add tracking numbers
dhl.description: Add one or more DHL tracking numbers to track (press Enter after each). You can also start empty and add tracking numbers later via the integration's options.

dpd.title: Log in with your DPD account
dpd.description: Log in with your myDPD account. All parcels (sent, received, returns) will then be detected automatically - unlike DHL, you don't need to enter tracking numbers manually.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Please check your username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to DPD. Please try again later.

dhl_options.description: Add or remove tracking numbers and adjust the update interval.

add_tracking_number.name: Add tracking number
add_tracking_number.description: Adds a DHL tracking number to Paketverfolgung, unless it's already tracked.
